newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bradesco still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bradesco still a hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it was maintaining its hold rating on Brazil's largest private bank Bradesco.
-- It said in a report that despite the bank's seemingly strong results in the 1996 fourth quarter, "we continue to remain cautious regarding the potential upside in Bradesco stock."
-- ING Barings also said it believes the bank's strong capitalization will slow any significant capital growth and profitability.
-- It said Bradesco's recently reported results have been driven mainly by lower loan-loss provisions rather than any significant changes in its operating environment.
-- Bradesco preferred shares were flat at 8.40 reais Thursday morning on the Sao Paulo bourse.
